title: First pass pinfo->pool conversion
description:
Automated find/replace of wmem_packet_scope() with pinfo->pool in all
files where it didn't cause a build failure.

I also tweaked a few of the docs which got caught up.

Repeat of https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3695 after fixing some pre-existing issues.

notes.body: Fixing the last legitimate pre-existing issue in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3711. The remaining failures (http2, dop, hf_dcd_h_arq_ack_delay) are false positives or unavoidable code-gen issues. Not sure if or how to override the build?

+The pinfo pool is scoped to the dissection of each packet, meaning that any
